section.catchline: Contribution to the Citizenship Scholarship Fund.

subsection.subsection: There is created an expendable special revenue fund known as the "Citizenship Scholarship Fund."
The fund shall consist of all amounts deposited into the fund in accordance with Subsection 59-10-1325(2).

section.subsection: Except as provided in Section 59-10-1304, a resident or nonresident individual who files an income tax return under this chapter may designate on the resident or nonresident individual's income tax return a contribution to be:deposited into the Citizenship Scholarship Fund; andexpended as provided in Subsection 59-10-1325(3).

subsection.subsection: Each year, the commission shall:disburse from the Citizenship Scholarship Fund all money deposited into the fund since the last disbursement; andtransfer the money to the Utah Board of Higher Education for distribution to students in accordance with Section 53H-11-416.
The commission shall complete the transfer of funds to the Utah Board of Higher Education by August 15 of each year.
